lines.text: He is flying. Look. He is flying to Heru.
lines.context: Hori, Ankhu's son, about four years old, delighted, laughing, on his father's shoulders at sunset. A memory. Scene: The Field That Waits. This line is a memory, heard as if from far away.

lines.text: He will not fall. You are holding me, and I am holding him.
